title: Chapter 609
paragraphs: Chapter 609
Episode 156. Purification of Chaos (13)
"It seems that the world of the little people is being smoothly purified, thanks to Valeria and the Mauin tribe."
Kashmir put down his tea cup and said.
"The Mauin tribe's boundary ability is indeed impressive. They are managing to carry out 'complete purification', which even Runcandel and Zipple are struggling with."
Quicantel nodded.
On the table where they sat, there was a letter Jin had sent to Valeria. It was a request to find the 'forgotten temple' of the previous cat gods with the Mauin tribe.
As per the letter, Valeria is currently searching for the forgotten temple with the Mauin tribe, and she is quickly achieving results.
"Last time, Valeria said that she could enhance the purification efficiency by combining the time authority with the Mauin tribe's boundary ability. Do you know about this, Kashimir?"

"Yes, I heard about it. Whether Valeria is opening up to us over time, she is sharing quite a lot of stories. She even plays with the kids sometimes. But it's still a bit hard to get comfortable with her."

"She's like a sharp knife. Should I say she reminds me of cold-hearted Jin? Anyway, the key to adding the power of time to the Mauin tribe's boundary is Enya. It's only possible if Enya can better handle the power of time."
"Enya is also training fervently every day, so that will happen soon. Qwaul's development is also going smoothly... By the time Jin returns, a lot will have changed. However."
Kashmir's eyes narrowed.
"I'm worried whether everything can continue smoothly. Especially the collusion between the royal family and Zipple is worrying, as we can't delve deeper into it right now."
Temar's left arm.
The physical body owned by the royal family is currently undetectable even with Valeria's record magic.
It's unknown whether it is still solely owned by the royal family, or whether it is shared with Zipple and new maining is being researched.
However, they could guess based on the current situation. Kashmir believed that it had already been shared with Zipple.
"The reason why Zipple is putting so much effort into purifying not only the Lutero Magic Federation but also the Empire's land, even though they are overwhelmed, is not just to pay for their sins."
Zipple's empire purification was mainly being carried out in the eastern regions close to the Lutero Magic Federation.

"When the purification of the eastern empire is completed and Zipple regains their power, the royal family will choose to join the Lutero Magic Federation along with the eastern region. While simply increasing the territory of the Lutero Magic Federation may not have great significance, the important thing is the technology of maining."

"If we can't find and kill the leaders of the royal family anyway, it's something that has to happen. What we need to focus on is strengthening the Mauin tribe's boundary and applying their boundary to Ince when the world of the little people is purified."
"Yes, I'm well aware. Anyway, we'll have to hope that Dante will get us the information about the maining. Let's wait and see."
In the Garden of Swords, the Tona brothers were sitting in the courtyard, smoking.

"Phew, this mission was quite tough. An 8-star martial artist class infector... The people of Kenga must be devastated. They've lost the person they were grooming to be the next family's top swordsman."
"Although we had to eliminate him because he was an infector, we should soon visit Kenga to express our condolences."
They had just returned after finishing a contamination area purification mission.
In the past 15 months, Runcandel had cleared over 70% of the contaminated areas that emerged for the first time after the Sword Emperor's Palace incident.

If things continued this way, the chaos that had engulfed Runcandel's territory would be suppressed in no time. But oddly enough, as the purified areas increased, reports of 'chaos infectors' being found were also increasing.
Especially recently, high-ranking martial artists and wizard infectors continued to be found.
Until now, Runcandel had swiftly suppressed them before they could cause major damage.
However, the members of the Huphester Alliance felt as if they were carrying a bomb that could explode at any time.
This time, the next top swordsman of Kenga was eradicated, and last time, one of the elders of Tucoga was infected and exterminated.
Even some of Runcandel's Knights had been infected several times, so despite being in a state of truce with Zipple, the Huphester Alliance's atmosphere was worse than before.
The silver lining was that the Lutero Magic Federation was in a similar situation.
"Ugh, I'm so tired. Do we rest for an hour and then move onto the next mission?"
"This time it's the Delki Kingdom, right? At least the area of infector outbreak is far from residential areas, so we will see fewer casualties."
"Anyway, it's good that we can rest here."

Originally, they mostly used the backyard of the Knights' dormitory. They did this especially when Myu and Anne were on standby in the dormitory, but recently, these women were not making life easy for the Tona brothers.
Not only that, but as riders, they were making significant contributions to every purification mission, and naturally, their standing within the family was improving.
Most family members understood that they were working hard to avoid being punished by Jin when he returned.
Not many people suspected that Myu and Anne had become the messengers of the Prophet.
"It's been over a year since our youngest left for secluded training..."
"Do you think he's doing well?"
"I suppose so. I have no idea how strong he will be when he returns."
"Didn't our mother say that she would make him the head of the family when he returns?"
"She didn't say it exactly like that, but it did feel like that."
Secluded training.
"Even though it is a truce, when the Huphester Alliance is more chaotic than ever, Jin left alone for training.
However, no one in the family criticized or despised Jin. Rather, they saw it as a way to verify his final qualifications before ascending to the throne.
Because of the achievements Jin had made over time. If it weren't for him, not only the Huphester Alliance but the entire world would have been in a much more terrible situation.
Moreover, since Rosa personally transported him, most of the members of Runcandel, like the Tona brothers, thought the same. When he returns, Jin will become the family head.
"I suddenly remember tormenting the youngest for choosing Barisada in the selection ritual without fear when he was young."
"It's a wonder we didn't die back then."
"It was a stormy night, otherwise it would have been the end."

"But we both started getting a little closer to the youngest since then. Myu and Anne, those crazy...(Daytona glanced around at this point) might not be bothering us because they are considering the youngest."
"When the youngest defeats those mad dogs (Heytona also glanced around), then let's be the first to end it! Kihiki, I'm behind. Really."
Boom, Quadduk-!
At that moment, a loud noise came from the inner courtyard, from the main house.
As Tona brothers, they couldn't help but feel their hearts sink. They mistakenly thought that Myu and Anne had overheard their backbiting and exploded in anger.
"Uh, uhaa. Sorry, sisters!"
But the source of the explosion was not Myu and Anne.
"Wait, this is not the mad dogs. It's from the main house! It's not a power that Myu and Anne could have......!"
Rumble......!
As if there was an earthquake, the entire Sword Garden was vibrating.
Like prey facing a beast, the Tona brothers froze instantly, even though they knew it wasn't Myu and Anne.
The only ones they knew who could release such energy in the family now were two people.
The Black Knight Captain Star.
And their mother, Rosa Runcandel.
Clang!
"What the heck. Hea, head!?"
Someone's head and the debris of a broken building fell in front of the Tona brothers.
It was the head of an elder. As soon as the Tona brothers saw it, they rushed towards the main house like madmen, and on the way, they saw the riders and knights running just like them.
"Sis, Sister Mary! What happened!?"
"Daytona, Heytona! You two don't go to the main house, control the surroundings!"
"Brother Diphus?"

"10th, 11th Riders, control it! It's an emergency! This incident must not be made public. Do you understand! Take all the Guardian Knights below the senior level, prepare for media control! It's the top priority mission until the situation is settled."
"Ah, understood!"
The Tona brothers disappeared to lead the Guardian Knights, and Myu and Anne kept running towards the main house."
The main building was already horribly destroyed, and nearby were bodies of those who were in the building and scattered injured people.
"… All the black knights and those below the upper ranks are forbidden from entering. Everyone wait outside!"
Stem, who had arrived first and was guarding the entrance, shouted.
Stem and the Black Knights and those above the ranks entered the broken main building, trying to calm their bewildered hearts.
In the middle of the main building, a woman in chaos was roaring with a sword in her hand.
Rosa Runcandel, she was the one who caused the rampage.
Diphus and Mary had no choice but to grit their teeth as soon as they saw her.
'Why on earth is mother going on a rampage at this time...?'
There was no time to wonder why Rosa suddenly went on a rampage. Rosa's rampage was an accident that no one could have predicted.
Even Diphus and Mary had a meeting with her just 30 minutes ago when she was fine.

If Rosa does not stop the rampage, Runcandel will fall into hell from today. It would be possible to suppress her since the knights and black knights were waiting inside the palace, but it would be difficult to handle the situation afterwards.
Rosa is the most important power in Runcandel, who is currently absent from Shirone, and is the acting head of the family.
As soon as it becomes known that she has a problem, Zipple will rush in with fire in his eyes.
The truce agreement could only be maintained when it was a burden for Runcandel and Zipple to fight each other to the end.
Fortunately.
Rosa stopped roaring when she saw the knights and black knights.
"Acting head of the family, are you conscious?"
"Knight Stem..."
"Thank goodness. If you are in a situation where you can make a rational judgment, give an order."
Thump!
At that word, Rosa pierced her chest with madness. It was a situation where she could control her mind, but her body did not move as she wanted.
A regeneration phenomenon was occurring from the chest pierced by the sword.
Rosa fiercely resisted her body trying to pull out the sword regardless of her will. Until all the energy of the body is drained due to excessive regeneration.
And before she lost consciousness and fell, she gave an order to Stem.
"Be sure to… Make it hidden. Today's event, everyone…"
Stem silently nodded.
"I will do so."
As soon as Rosa fell, Stem pulled out the madness stuck in her chest. Slowly, the surrounding chaos seeped in as a cure and showed a regenerating appearance.
Then, Myu and Anne outside were saying in a calm voice.
"Mother will know now. If you continue to go against his will, you will eventually face ruin."
